models_evaluated: 4 slide-level AI classification models (2 scanners, 2 organs)

links.outcome: AI slide-level prediction robustness to image blur perturbation
links.effect: Blur metrics did not differ between concordant and discordant slides (p>0.05 except one pair); performance stayed robust at blur radius 1 (top 8.6% and 12.15% of blurriness); slide embedding cosine similarity >0.99 up to ±3 μm.
links.quote: Model performance remained robust even at a high blur level (radius = 1), where the patch image had a Laplacian variance of 133.14 and a wavelet score of 1667.98, corresponding to the top 8.6% and 12.15% of blurriness, respectively, in our dataset.

screen.reason: This study evaluates the robustness of digital pathology AI models against varying levels of whole slide image blurriness (an artifact analysis), but does not test or evaluate an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
